claims.normalized_claim: The Repo-Dorfaeltester's three donor roles (Graph, Memory, Wiki) resolve to Graphify-Labs/graphify, DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp and hereisSwapnil/memwiki respectively; each is an implementation donor (not a runtime dependency), pinned at a specific snapshot with no automatic upstream updates, absorbed as SHADED/Alfred-owned code with license/copyright/NOTICE provenance kept intact.

GRAPHIFY_UPSTREAM=https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify

Policy:
Upstream is an implementation donor, not a runtime dependency.
After ingestion, Alfret/Shaded owns the integrated implementation.
No automatic upstream updates.
No runtime dependency on donor repositories.
Required license / copyright / NOTICE provenance remains intact.
